name: GHCN-Daily
description: Daily weather observations from ~120,000 land stations worldwide - max/min temperature, precipitation, snowfall, snow depth - many running back to the 1940s and some to the 1800s. The reference source for 'what was the weather actually like here, every day, for eighty years'.

temporal.start: 1750s (a handful; most US stations from the 1940s)

license.name: US Government public domain
license.redistribution: free to redistribute; attribution to NOAA NCEI expected

access.size_hint: one station-CSV is 1-5 MB; the whole archive is ~15 GB
access.rate_limit: none published; www.ncei.noaa.gov is slow under load
access.etiquette: fetch per station, not the whole archive, unless you really need it

fields: TMAX and TMIN in tenths of a degree C
PRCP in tenths of a mm

probes.description: Reagan National (USW00013743), the long gapless record for the DC area
The path most tutorials still tell you to use
probes.known_broken: NCEI retired /pub/data/ghcnd/ - every tutorial and blog post older than ~2024 sends you here. Use the AWS mirror in ghcn-stations-inventory instead.

recipes.title: One station, quality-flagged values dropped
recipes.code:
import csv, io, urllib.request
url = 'https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/data/global-historical-climatology-network-daily/access/USW00013743.csv'
rows = csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(urllib.request.urlopen(url).read().decode()))
for r in rows:
    # QFLAG is the middle character of the ATTRIBUTES triple; non-blank means failed QC
    if r.get('TMAX') and r['TMAX_ATTRIBUTES'].split(',')[1].strip() == '':
        print(r['DATE'], int(r['TMAX']) / 10.0)  # tenths of a degree C

gotchas.trap: The old ncei.noaa.gov/pub/data/ghcnd/* paths 404 now, including the station list and inventory that every tutorial links to.
gotchas.fix: Use the AWS Open Data mirror (see ghcn-stations-inventory). The per-station /data/.../access/ CSVs are unaffected.

gotchas.trap: Temperatures are in tenths of a degree Celsius and precipitation in tenths of a millimetre. Forget the divide and you get a 340 degree August.
gotchas.fix: TMAX/10 for C, PRCP/10 for mm.

gotchas.trap: Failed-QC values are present in the file, not removed.
gotchas.fix: Every element has a companion <EL>_ATTRIBUTES of MFLAG,QFLAG,SFLAG. Drop the row when QFLAG is non-blank.
